steps.comment: And no blushes out of it. The ladder's one Register A moment is the drain cock, and it sits inside a conditional branch on Merribell being in the room - four faults reported accurately is only a moment if somebody present treats it as an ordinary sentence. Bram is on his own here, so Ott answers in one word and there is nothing to count. clanging_cast runs the same four rungs with Merribell and gets one. This check is the other half of that pair: it fails if the condition is ever dropped.

steps.label: and no blushes out of it, because Merribell is not in the room

forty bolts of oilskin are wanted

steps.comment: The order chain: nine beats on VAR_OTT_ORDER, one per conversation, for as long as the errand is outstanding. Two of them are Register A and nothing anywhere else in the suite walks them, so the ending's threshold was riding on five of Ott's six blushes that no scenario had ever executed. They land on the third and the fifth.

forty bolts of oilskin, on account, at Wick and Barrow

steps.comment: The flying chain: seven beats on VAR_OTT_FLYING, and three of them are Register A. Its last write is what sets SW_OTT_MATERIALS, which is the one switch that means Ott has nothing left owing - every page appended to her below these ladders requires it, so this is also the check that the ladders can actually be finished.
